scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --filter '!@abhyas/shared' run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:db: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter @abhyas/api run test:db
scripts.db:seed:admin: pnpm --filter @abhyas/api run build && pnpm --filter @abhyas/api run seed:admin
scripts.db:seed:catalog: pnpm --filter @abhyas/api run build && pnpm --filter @abhyas/api run seed:catalog
